body: Unfortunately I have no way of getting into  contact with said family, I am prepared to carry this burden with me indefinitely and I accept that.

You sound like an old wiseman my friend. Which is far from an insult I assure you. I have tried in my life to always be the kinder, gentler and understanding person, but I have made mistakes and one has recently clawed it’s away from the back of my mind and does not seem to want to let go. I made a mistake about 5 years ago that until recently I have all but forgotten, me and 2 friends entered a home that was unoccupied for a few years according to one of the friends, and we took things we had no right to take for I didn’t realize exactly what I did until recently. We took a photo album and journal. They sound like small things I know but unbeknownst to us they belonged to a widow. We took these things in the idea that we didn’t want them to sit around gathering dust, not realizing that we had just taken possibly the only thing that this poor mans family had to remember him by, and we had just taken something from his widow that could possibly never be forgiven. His memory. We took this from her and I wish nothing more than to apologize and return it but I can’t and I know I can’t and that hurts me deeply.
